raw_posts.name: Rakazo
raw_posts.tagline: The open source Grok Bot alternative you actually own
raw_posts.description: Rakazo gives you AI teammates that keep working after you close the chat. Each bot has its own memory, routines and computer, with a browser you can watch and take over. Open source and self-hosted: any model, your keys, your machine. Web, desktop and mobile.

raw_posts.name: Frevana Multiplayer
raw_posts.tagline: AI that grows your business alongside your team
raw_posts.description: Frevana runs AI agent apps that find customers, create content, and automate busywork. Now it's multiplayer: invite your team with a link, share agents and skills, and build on each other's work. Your best workflow becomes everyone's.

raw_posts.name: Tulvo
raw_posts.tagline: Smart & adaptive workspace to manage all your work
raw_posts.description: Most small businesses run on 10 or more apps that never share data. Docs in one place, tasks in another, customers in a spreadsheet, forms and the website somewhere else. Tulvo puts all of it on one set of connected data. Describe your business in a sentence and Tulvo AI sets up the databases, boards, docs and reports for it. Bring in data from forms and webhooks, automate work, connect your own AI through MCP and host live sites. Try for free for 30 days and grab 50% OFF during Black Friday.

raw_posts.name: HuntMonitor
raw_posts.tagline: Watch today's hunt live: points, speed, rank moves
raw_posts.description: HuntMonitor is a live dashboard for today's Product Hunt race. Sort by points, comments, upvote speed, or hunter. Keep one tab open to see if a launch is climbing or slipping. Open any row for the day's points chart. Updates live, snapshots every 15 minutes.

raw_posts.name: Talyn
raw_posts.tagline: Run Claude Code and Codex in parallel cloud sandboxes
raw_posts.description: Talyn runs Claude Code and Codex in parallel cloud sandboxes, on the plan you already pay for. Close the laptop and come back to a diff, or to a pull request that is already green. Free with 10 box-hours a month. For GitHub, on macOS, Windows, Linux, or the browser.

raw_posts.name: Agentic Canvas
raw_posts.tagline: Free Agentic Design Canvas - A visual way to work with AI
raw_posts.description: Agentic Canvas by AgentGrid.io is a free, agent-first design tool where humans and AI agents work together on real HTML. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Muse AI, Instinct, Hermes, Cursor, Codex, or any MCP-compatible agent. Design visually, edit by hand, and let AI pick up where you left off. Free, local, no signup required.

raw_posts.name: Remindly
raw_posts.tagline: Notes that remind you, on iPhone, iPad, Mac and web
raw_posts.description: Remindly is a fast notes app where any note can carry a reminder: one-time, repeating, all-day, or when you arrive somewhere. Capture by typing, voice, scan, or the web clipper. Syncs across iPhone, iPad, Mac and web. Imports your Evernote library.

raw_posts.name: TwoBucket
raw_posts.tagline: Beginner-friendly mobile detailing software for bookings
raw_posts.description: TwoBucket is beginner-friendly mobile detailing software for solo detailers and small teams. Customers send their vehicle, its condition and photos from your booking page or website. You send a quote they approve online, then an invoice they pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay into your own Stripe or Square account, with deposits and tips. Visits sync to Google Calendar or iCloud. iPhone, Android and web, or ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok or Muse. $20/month, 7-day free trial.

raw_posts.name: Perit Marketplace
raw_posts.tagline: Sell your data and RL tasks to frontier AI labs
raw_posts.description: Perit Marketplace turns your data and expertise into training work for frontier AI labs. Two ways in: submit data you own (audio, video, code, docs, CAD and more; 29 datasets listed so far), or build RL tasks and benchmarks on our platform using our VMs and model credits. We pitch them to labs, and approved experts scale to hundreds of tasks a week. Built by Perit (YC F26), now past $11M in revenue in 4.5 months.

raw_posts.name: Polylane for Security
raw_posts.tagline: Catch exploitable vulnerabilities before they ship
raw_posts.description: Polylane reviews production-bound pull requests for exploitable security flaws. Findings trace attacker-controlled input to the vulnerable line, with the evidence and suggested fix. Safe candidates are ruled out with a reason. Daily dependency scans find known CVEs, prioritise the most severe and open fix pull requests on active, deployed repositories.
